_comment: Retirement Crossword clue-generation. varietyAngles rotate by seed so two users on the same theme get different word sets.

locale.nativeLine: - Write in clear English for adults and retirees.

difficultyLine: Difficulty '{difficulty}': easy/relaxed = shorter common words (4–8 letters) + direct clues; medium/classic = everyday words (4–10) + clear descriptive clues; hard/challenge = longer words (5–12) + moderately indirect but fair clues — never obscure trivia.
